message.name: Message
message.purpose: Turn Tone foundation roles into implementation-ready messaging primitives for intent, severity, anatomy, recovery, accessibility, localization, and UI mapping.

roles.use: Info, success, warning, danger, neutral, and assistive message purpose.
Low, medium, high, and blocking operational consequence.
Title, body, consequence, action, recovery, and support path.
Live region, alert, focus, and status behavior.
Length, clarity, ambiguity, and translation guardrails.

productExamples.example: Danger message states consequence, recovery path, and primary/secondary actions before confirmation.
Message distinguishes invalid code from expired code and offers resend or alternate path.
Message explains location permission or route provider failure with fallback list.

agentInstructions: Choose message intent before UI component.
Always include consequence and recovery for danger or blocking states.
Map accessibility behavior before rendering toast, alert, inline error, banner, dialog, or empty state.
rejectIf: Copy describes what happened but not what to do next.
Danger message has no consequence or recovery path.
Message uses humor, metaphor, or vague language in operational contexts.
Agent renders feedback without accessible announcement behavior.
